sub_goal: Try to add the most recently completed subgoal on top of the existing historical operations. Please do not delete any existing historical operation. Click on the text area to activate it for editing. 4. Long press the backspace button on the keyboard to clear the existing text in the file. 5. Type the content "inNqu8UNNtyXBHCZpYp7" into the text area. 6. Click at the end of the text to position the cursor for clearing the content. 7. Long press the backspace button on the keyboard to delete the extra line and characters. 8. Clicked the backspace key to delete the character "m". 9. Click the save icon to save the changes to the file. 10. Click the three dots (options menu) in the top right corner to access file management options. 11. Click on "File settings" in the options menu. 12. Press the back button to dismiss the "File settings" menu. 13. Press the back button to return to the file explorer view.
